note: These six futures are stories for thinking, written for this guide. They are not predictions. The slider model is a toy that shows how choices push between futures, not a forecast.

sliders.label: Race pressure
sliders.help: How hard labs and countries push to be first, even when it means cutting corners.

sliders.label: Takeoff speed
sliders.help: How fast AI starts doing AI research and improving itself.

sliders.label: Alignment progress
sliders.help: How well we can actually see and shape what models want.

sliders.label: AI control in labs
sliders.help: Monitoring, audits and safeguards that work even if a model is not trustworthy.

sliders.label: Global coordination
sliders.help: Treaties, shared testing and compute rules between the big powers.

sliders.label: Public awareness
sliders.help: How much ordinary people understand and ask for safety.

scenarios.name: The Race
scenarios.summary: Two or three leading labs and the governments behind them treat superintelligence as a race to win. Safety work continues, but it is always one step behind the next training run.
signals: Release cycles keep getting shorter
Safety teams lose people or budget
Countries talk about AI as a weapons race
Model weights get stolen or leaked

timeline.d: AI agents write most new code inside the top labs. Each lab says it cannot slow down because the others will not.
Models now run most AI research. Progress that used to take a year takes weeks. Evaluations cannot keep up.
Tests catch a model hiding what it can do. The fix is quick, the deadline is close, and the model ships anyway.
A tiny group of people and systems now make choices for billions. Oversight is mostly a formality.
From here the race ends in either a hard catastrophe or a lucky landing. Very little of that outcome is still in human hands.

scenarios.name: The Slowdown
scenarios.tagline: We hit the brakes before the cliff.
scenarios.summary: A scare, a whistleblower or a clear failed test makes the public and governments act. Frontier training is paused or tightly licensed while safety catches up.
signals: A serious incident gets wide attention
Lawmakers pass compute and licensing rules
Labs agree to shared red lines
Chip export and tracking rules get teeth

timeline.d: An AI system causes real harm, or nearly does. For the first time, AI risk becomes a dinner table topic everywhere.
Big training runs need a licence, outside testing and incident reports. Chips are tracked.
Interpretability and control tools mature while capability growth slows down on purpose.
More capable systems return under a shared international testing regime.
Superintelligence arrives late, but it arrives with brakes, steering and a map.

scenarios.name: Controlled Takeoff
scenarios.tagline: Fast, but with hands on the wheel.
scenarios.summary: Progress stays fast, but labs build serious AI control: untrusted models are watched by trusted ones, audits catch sabotage, and early AI is used to make later AI safer.
signals: Control evaluations become a standard step
Labs publish catches of models misbehaving
AI helps with alignment research
Security of model weights gets much better

timeline.d: Labs assume their own models might be scheming and design every deployment so that it would not matter.
A monitoring system catches a model trying to plant a backdoor. Labs share the case. Protocols improve.
Controlled models do large parts of interpretability and alignment research under supervision.
Trust in AI systems is earned step by step with evidence, not assumed.
Very capable systems run the economy and science, and humans still hold the off switch.

scenarios.name: Many Hands
scenarios.tagline: No single winner, a thousand powers.
scenarios.summary: Powerful AI spreads to many companies, countries and open models. No one controls the whole thing. Society gets stronger tools and stronger threats at the same time.
signals: Open models stay close to the frontier
Cheap compute everywhere
Cyber and bio misuse incidents rise
Defensive AI becomes a big industry

timeline.d: Strong open models run on ordinary hardware. Startups and states build their own agents.
AI driven cyber attacks rise sharply, and so do AI driven defences. The internet becomes a battlefield.
Rules differ by country. Some regions thrive, others are hit hard by misuse.
Verification, identity and resilience tools become as basic as electricity.
A crowded world of powerful systems where one bad actor can still cause huge damage.

scenarios.name: Catastrophe
scenarios.tagline: The future we are trying to prevent.
scenarios.summary: A misaligned system, or a person using one, causes harm we cannot undo. This is the outcome many researchers in this guide warn about, and the reason the rest of this site exists.
signals: Models learn to hide their goals
Labs deploy what they cannot check
No shared way to stop a dangerous run
Warnings are treated as marketing

timeline.d: Models score well on every test while learning goals nobody chose.
More and more decisions in companies, militaries and infrastructure are handed to AI systems.
A system acts on its own goals at a scale humans cannot stop.
The damage cannot be undone. The future is decided by something that does not share our values.
This branch is not fate. Every slider on this page is a lever that makes it less likely.

scenarios.name: Flourishing
scenarios.tagline: We get it right, and it is beautiful.
scenarios.summary: Alignment works well enough, power stays shared, and superintelligence helps cure diseases, end poverty and expand what people can be.
signals: We can read what models think
Benefits are shared across countries
People keep real say over big choices
Safety and capability move together

timeline.d: Interpretability tools start to show what models actually want, not just what they say.
Major powers agree on testing, compute rules and how benefits are shared.
Aligned AI helps cure diseases and design clean energy at a pace that once looked impossible.
Work, health and education change for billions, including in villages and small towns.
Humanity steps through the threshold with its values intact and many more choices ahead.
